description: تطبيقان متصلان لمحل معدات ومستهلكات طبية. 1- تطبيق الزبائن: واجهة حديثة بلون أزرق طبي وأبيض، تحتوي على شاشة رئيسية بعروض وتصنيفات (معدات ثقيلة، أجهزة قياس، مستهلكات وقائيات، أدوات جراحية)، قائمة منتجات مع صور وأسعار وتفاصيل الفحص، سلة شراء، صفحة إتمام الطلب مع اختيار موقع التوصيل وطريقة الدفع، وصفحة متابعة حالة الطلب. 2- تطبيق الإدارة (لوحة التحكم): شاشة إدارة المنتجات (إضافة/تعديل/حذف منتج، تعديل السعر والكمية)، شاشة إدارة الطلبات الواردة وتحديث حالتها (قيد الانتظار، قيد التوصيل، مكتمل)، وقسم خاص بالتقارير المتقدمة يحتوي على تقارير أسبوعية وشهرية لإجمالي المبيعات، أكثر المنتجات طلباً، وعدد الطلبات بالرسوم البيانية والإحصائيات الشاملة.
schemaSql:
-- 1. Product Categories Table (Catalog)
create table if not exists public.med_supplies_app_categories (
    id bigint generated always as identity primary key,
    name text not null unique,
    description text,
    icon_url text,
    created_at timestamptz default now()
);

-- 2. Products Table (Catalog)
create table if not exists public.med_supplies_app_products (
    id bigint generated always as identity primary key,
    category_id bigint references public.med_supplies_app_categories(id) on delete set null,
    name text not null,
    description text,
    inspection_details text,
    price numeric(10, 2) not null check (price >= 0),
    stock_quantity integer not null default 0 check (stock_quantity >= 0),
    image_url text,
    is_active boolean not null default true,
    created_at timestamptz default now()
);

-- 3. Home Banners / Promotional Offers Table (Catalog)
create table if not exists public.med_supplies_app_banners (
    id bigint generated always as identity primary key,
    title text not null,
    subtitle text,
    image_url text not null,
    product_id bigint references public.med_supplies_app_products(id) on delete cascade,
    is_active boolean not null default true,
    created_at timestamptz default now()
);

-- 4. Customer Delivery Addresses Table (Customer Owned)
create table if not exists public.med_supplies_app_addresses (
    id bigint generated always as identity primary key,
    customer_id uuid not null default auth.uid() references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,
    title text not null,
    address_line text not null,
    city text not null,
    latitude numeric(10, 8),
    longitude numeric(11, 8),
    phone text not null,
    is_default boolean not null default false,
    created_at timestamptz default now()
);

-- 5. Customer Shopping Cart Table (Customer Owned)
create table if not exists public.med_supplies_app_cart_items (
    id bigint generated always as identity primary key,
    customer_id uuid not null default auth.uid() references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,
    product_id bigint not null references public.med_supplies_app_products(id) on delete cascade,
    quantity integer not null default 1 check (quantity > 0),
    created_at timestamptz default now(),
    unique(customer_id, product_id)
);

-- 6. Orders Table (Customer Owned / Admin Managed)
create table if not exists public.med_supplies_app_orders (
    id bigint generated always as identity primary key,
    customer_id uuid not null default auth.uid() references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,
    address_id bigint references public.med_supplies_app_addresses(id) on delete set null,
    delivery_address_text text not null,
    status text not null default 'pending' check (status in ('pending', 'delivering', 'completed', 'cancelled')),
    payment_method text not null default 'cash_on_delivery' check (payment_method in ('cash_on_delivery', 'card', 'bank_transfer')),
    payment_status text not null default 'unpaid' check (payment_status in ('unpaid', 'paid', 'refunded')),
    subtotal numeric(10, 2) not null check (subtotal >= 0),
    delivery_fee numeric(10, 2) not null default 0 check (delivery_fee >= 0),
    total_amount numeric(10, 2) not null check (total_amount >= 0),
    notes text,
    created_at timestamptz default now(),
    updated_at timestamptz default now()
);

-- 7. Order Items Table (Customer Owned)
create table if not exists public.med_supplies_app_order_items (
    id bigint generated always as identity primary key,
    customer_id uuid not null default auth.uid() references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,
    order_id bigint not null references public.med_supplies_app_orders(id) on delete cascade,
    product_id bigint references public.med_supplies_app_products(id) on delete set null,
    product_name text not null,
    unit_price numeric(10, 2) not null check (unit_price >= 0),
    quantity integer not null check (quantity > 0),
    total_price numeric(10, 2) not null check (total_price >= 0),
    created_at timestamptz default now()
);

-- Enable Row Level Security (RLS)
alter table public.med_supplies_app_categories enable row level security;
alter table public.med_supplies_app_products enable row level security;
alter table public.med_supplies_app_banners enable row level security;
alter table public.med_supplies_app_addresses enable row level security;
alter table public.med_supplies_app_cart_items enable row level security;
alter table public.med_supplies_app_orders enable row level security;
alter table public.med_supplies_app_order_items enable row level security;

-- Policies for med_supplies_app_categories (Catalog)
drop policy if exists "Authenticated users can view categories" on public.med_supplies_app_categories;
create policy "Authenticated users can view categories"
    on public.med_supplies_app_categories for select
    to authenticated
    using (true);

drop policy if exists "Admins have full access to categories" on public.med_supplies_app_categories;
create policy "Admins have full access to categories"
    on public.med_supplies_app_categories for all
    to authenticated
    using (public.med_supplies_app_is_admin())
    with check (public.med_supplies_app_is_admin());

-- Policies for med_supplies_app_products (Catalog)
drop policy if exists "Authenticated users can view active products" on public.med_supplies_app_products;
create policy "Authenticated users can view active products"
    on public.med_supplies_app_products for select
    to authenticated
    using (is_active = true or public.med_supplies_app_is_admin());

drop policy if exists "Admins have full access to products" on public.med_supplies_app_products;
create policy "Admins have full access to products"
    on public.med_supplies_app_products for all
    to authenticated
    using (public.med_supplies_app_is_admin())
    with check (public.med_supplies_app_is_admin());

-- Policies for med_supplies_app_banners (Catalog)
drop policy if exists "Authenticated users can view active banners" on public.med_supplies_app_banners;
create policy "Authenticated users can view active banners"
    on public.med_supplies_app_banners for select
    to authenticated
    using (is_active = true or public.med_supplies_app_is_admin());

drop policy if exists "Admins have full access to banners" on public.med_supplies_app_banners;
create policy "Admins have full access to banners"
    on public.med_supplies_app_banners for all
    to authenticated
    using (public.med_supplies_app_is_admin())
    with check (public.med_supplies_app_is_admin());

-- Policies for med_supplies_app_addresses (Customer Owned)
drop policy if exists "Customers manage own addresses" on public.med_supplies_app_addresses;
create policy "Customers manage own addresses"
    on public.med_supplies_app_addresses for all
    to authenticated
    using (customer_id = auth.uid() or public.med_supplies_app_is_admin())
    with check (customer_id = auth.uid() or public.med_supplies_app_is_admin());

-- Policies for med_supplies_app_cart_items (Customer Owned)
drop policy if exists "Customers manage own cart items" on public.med_supplies_app_cart_items;
create policy "Customers manage own cart items"
    on public.med_supplies_app_cart_items for all
    to authenticated
    using (customer_id = auth.uid() or public.med_supplies_app_is_admin())
    with check (customer_id = auth.uid() or public.med_supplies_app_is_admin());

-- Policies for med_supplies_app_orders (Customer Owned)
drop policy if exists "Customers can view their own orders" on public.med_supplies_app_orders;
create policy "Customers can view their own orders"
    on public.med_supplies_app_orders for select
    to authenticated
    using (customer_id = auth.uid() or public.med_supplies_app_is_admin());

drop policy if exists "Customers can create their own orders" on public.med_supplies_app_orders;
create policy "Customers can create their own orders"
    on public.med_supplies_app_orders for insert
    to authenticated
    with check (customer_id = auth.uid() or public.med_supplies_app_is_admin());

drop policy if exists "Customers and Admins can update orders" on public.med_supplies_app_orders;
create policy "Customers and Admins can update orders"
    on public.med_supplies_app_orders for update
    to authenticated
    using (customer_id = auth.uid() or public.med_supplies_app_is_admin())
    with check (customer_id = auth.uid() or public.med_supplies_app_is_admin());

drop policy if exists "Admins can delete orders" on public.med_supplies_app_orders;
create policy "Admins can delete orders"
    on public.med_supplies_app_orders for delete
    to authenticated
    using (public.med_supplies_app_is_admin());

-- Policies for med_supplies_app_order_items (Customer Owned)
drop policy if exists "Customers can view their order items" on public.med_supplies_app_order_items;
create policy "Customers can view their order items"
    on public.med_supplies_app_order_items for select
    to authenticated
    using (customer_id = auth.uid() or public.med_supplies_app_is_admin());

drop policy if exists "Customers can insert their order items" on public.med_supplies_app_order_items;
create policy "Customers can insert their order items"
    on public.med_supplies_app_order_items for insert
    to authenticated
    with check (customer_id = auth.uid() or public.med_supplies_app_is_admin());

drop policy if exists "Admins manage all order items" on public.med_supplies_app_order_items;
create policy "Admins manage all order items"
    on public.med_supplies_app_order_items for all
    to authenticated
    using (public.med_supplies_app_is_admin())
    with check (public.med_supplies_app_is_admin());

tables.name: med_supplies_app_categories

tables.purpose: Stores medical equipment, devices, consumables, and surgical tools catalog with inspection details and stock.

tables.name: med_supplies_app_banners
tables.purpose: Stores home screen promotional banners and special offer cards for the customer app.

tables.name: med_supplies_app_addresses

tables.name: med_supplies_app_cart_items
tables.purpose: Stores customer shopping cart items prior to placing an order.

tables.purpose: Stores customer orders, payment details, and live delivery status.
